:::{#def-overfitting}
#### Overfitting

**Overfitting** occurs when a model fits the training data well
but predicts poorly for new observations.
It results from including too many predictors
relative to the effective sample size.

:::

::: notes
In @exr-overfitting,
the higher-degree polynomials fit the 20 training cars more closely
than the degree-2 model does,
but they do not predict the 12 held-out cars better.
:::
